catalog.container_strategy: Build CPU tools and the access daemon in dev; deploy target tools plus a separately reviewed host access-daemon profile. Keep perf_event and MSR/PCI access modes available. Do not install setuid helpers implicitly.
catalog.purpose: Measure CPU topology, affinity, hardware counters, region markers and memory bandwidth with architecture-specific metric groups.
qualification_gaps: A physical target CPU, kernel, PMU and container launch profile must pass feature-specific collection probes; an installed executable is not full runtime qualification.
Full uncore access may require host MSR/PCI access or access daemon; perf_event mode alone is not equivalent.
No frequency-setting tool may change a formal timing machine during a campaign.
catalog.size_basis: complete HTTP GET, byte count and SHA-256 computed locally
catalog.title: LIKWID CPU profiling toolkit

private_runtime_profile.relocation_scope: Declared Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 independent prefixes; helper paths resolved relative to loaded LIKWID library; exact private Perl runtime; no PMU or daemon qualification.

activation: Use the resolved absolute command paths shown here. No system-wide PATH or alternatives changes are made.

examples.description: List counter groups for this CPU

locations.label: LIKWID tools
locations.purpose: Version-specific topology, affinity, perfctr and benchmark commands

locations.label: Metric groups
locations.purpose: Architecture-specific performance groups and reference data

locations.label: Installed API examples and checks
locations.purpose: Read-only API client source and the resource check entry point; runtime reports keep hardware limitations explicit.

notes: The source recipe selects the accessdaemon backend; usable counters require a separately reviewed host daemon/MSR/PCI arrangement. No daemon is enabled by the check.
The topology check is non-privileged. Benchmark kernels and counter collection are separate, explicit operations.
Source-built LIKWID 5.5.2 and APT LIKWID 5.2.2 can coexist via their distinct command paths.

The access and frequency helpers are included as ordinary 0755 executables. No host ownership/setuid activation, service startup, MSR module loading or device-policy change is performed. A host administrator may configure the documented upstream access mode explicitly.

The complete profile uses independent prefixes with bound relative launchers. Original sources and complete exact private DEBs are retained. Counter collection and privileged daemon activation are not qualified.
usage.summary: Inspect CPU topology and use LIKWID affinity, counters and microbenchmarks when explicitly requested.
